rationale: Thomas, as the most senior majority justice and the one with the clearest and most confident originalist reasoning grounding the majority's constitutional analysis, is the most likely opinion author; his Territory Clause framework provides the structural backbone that unites the majority. Barrett's methodological hesitation about sequential resolution of threshold questions and Sotomayor's distinct emphasis on Puerto Rico's constitutional disclosure rights make separate concurrences plausible, while the four dissenters are likely to produce at least one dissent anchored in the clear-statement rule.
